footnotes: The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss narrowed to $66.8M from $81.5M.
The net loss narrowed to $59.0M, or −$0.47 per share, from $70.8M. Operating cash flow was −$50.7M and free cash flow −$52.0M, versus −$61.3M.
sources: Nautilus Biotechnology, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We are a development stage company that has incurred net losses in every period to date, has not yet commercialized any products…
Our business is entirely dependent on the successful development and commercialization of our proteomics platform…
We may not compete successfully with our initial or future products in the highly competitive life sciences technology market
We are dependent upon third parties for certain aspects of the development and commercialization of the Nautilus Voyager platform
Our business depends significantly on research and development spending by pharmaceutical companies as well as by academic institutions…
We may not be able to launch our Nautilus Voyager platform successfully and even if it is successful…
strategy: Establish Iterative Mapping as a differentiated measurement approach for proteomics
Enable multiple applications on a single platform
Broadscale proteomics, intended to enable large-scale interrogation of canonical proteins across biological states; and
Targeted proteoform analysis, intended to resolve specific protein forms, modifications, and variants…
